notes: Identity Machine on Robinhood Chain (4663). Deploys the four application contracts alone: no new token, pool or distributor. Deploy in this order with zero ETH; nothing is called after deployment and no contract has an owner, admin or upgrade path. DrandBeacon() verifies drand evmnet (BN254, 3-second rounds) signatures on chain. IdentityMachine(imd, beacon, dev, seatRoot, basePrice, delay) is the game: imd = the existing IMD token on Robinhood Chain (0x5f7bb59365ce557c26dbcaa4ee9d39a4b95b7127); beacon = the DrandBeacon above; dev = $owner, the address that receives the 2% developer share of every mint and has no other power; seatRoot = the Merkle root of the Agent Core seat snapshot (Ethereum block 26132002); basePrice = 0.10 IMD; delay = 172800 seconds, so minting opens 48 hours after deployment. Its constructor creates the Parts inventory ledger bound to itself (read it with inventory()). MachineViews(machine) is read-only. EthMinter(machine, poolManager, quoter, fee, tickSpacing) buys IMD with ETH through the existing Uniswap v4 ETH/IMD pool (PoolManager 0x8366a39cc670b4001a1121b8f6a443a643e40951, Quoter 0x8dc178efb8111bb0973dd9d722ebeff267c98f94, fee 10000, tick spacing 100) and mints in the same transaction; its constructor checks that the machine has code and that fee and tick spacing are valid, while the pool contracts and the quoter-to-PoolManager relationship are checked on first use, before any quote or swap.
